mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_service_record (activity_id, volunteer_id, service_hours, state) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{volunteerId}, #{serviceHours}, #{state})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} AND activity_id = #{activityId}
SELECT activity_id, volunteer_id, COALESCE(service_hours, 0) AS service_hours, state FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId}
SELECT SUM(service_hours) FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} AND state = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} AND state = #{state}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} AND activity_id = #{activityId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND state = 1) AS num1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND state = 0) AS num0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND state = 2) AS num2
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} AND activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(vsr.service_hours) FROM volunteer_service_record vsr JOIN volunteer_activity va ON vsr.activity_id = va.activity_id WHERE va.team_id = #{teamId} AND vsr.state = 1

SELECT va.activity_id, CASE WHEN vsr.volunteer_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE vsr.volunteer_id END AS volunteer_id, CASE WHEN vsr.volunteer_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE vsr.service_hours END AS service_hours, CASE WHEN vsr.volunteer_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE vsr.state END AS state FROM volunteer_activity va LEFT JOIN volunteer_service_record vsr ON va.activity_id = vsr.activity_id AND vsr.state = 0 WHERE va.team_id = #{teamId} AND va.state = 1 ORDER BY va.activity_id

SELECT vsr.*, va.start_date FROM volunteer_service_record vsr JOIN volunteer_activity va ON vsr.activity_id = va.activity_id WHERE vsr.volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} AND vsr.state = 1 AND va.state=1 ORDER BY va.start_date
SELECT SUM(service_hours) FROM volunteer_service_record WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(vsr.service_hours), 0) FROM volunteer v LEFT JOIN volunteer_service_record vsr ON v.volunteer_id = vsr.volunteer_id GROUP BY v.volunteer_id
